overview: The committee addressed a controversial unexcused absence policy regarding a global climate strike and established a new subcommittee for the Medford High School Master Vision Plan. The meeting also included reports on middle school math curriculum implementation, dyslexia screening pilot programs, and the recognition of scientific and environmental achievements.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes of September 9, 2019, along with various bills, transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Recognition of Joseph Farah
items.summary: Recognized alumnus Joseph Farah for his contributions as the only undergraduate author on the Event Horizon Telescope Project's first image of a black hole.

items.title: Recognition of Ron Morin
items.summary: Honored outgoing Executive Director Ron Morin for his leadership in preserving the Middlesex Fells Reservation and protecting the 90-millimeter meadow from development.

items.title: Climate Strike Communication and Absenteeism Policy
items.summary: Referred the district's absenteeism policy regarding student participation in outside events to the Policy Subcommittee following a debate over treating the global climate strike as an unexcused absence.

items.title: Building and Ground Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Accepted the report on high school speed bumps, flashing speed signs, and repairs to the McGlynn complex sidewalks.

items.title: Establishment of High School Master Vision Plan
items.summary: Approved the creation of a Master Vision Plan subcommittee to develop a long-term strategy for Medford High School repair, maintenance, and capital funding.

items.title: Superintendent’s Report and Updates
items.summary: Received updates on student scholarships, safety protocols following the discovery of a construction bit at McGlynn Elementary, and local community festivals.

items.title: Grants and Event Permits
items.summary: Approved a $1,500 PFLAG grant for LGBTQ+ support and a liquor permit for the upcoming Taste of Italy fundraiser.

items.title: Middle School Mathematics Program Update
items.summary: Reviewed the implementation of the Illustrative Math curriculum and voted to require an update on backlogged instructional supplies and teacher materials at the next meeting.

items.title: Middle School Athletics Report
items.summary: Reported high student participation in the new middle school sports programs and the successful re-establishment of the Greater Boston League.

items.title: Dyslexia Screening Tools Pilot
items.summary: Outlined the deployment of three different state-funded screening pilots across elementary schools to identify students at risk for reading failure.

items.title: English Learner Department Report
items.summary: Presented details on summer STEM enrichment programs, recent enrollment data for English Learners, and a partnership with Lesley University for teacher internships.
